edits.also: 가리키던 손 → 갈래 끝을 쥐고 당김 · 가지 금메달 지움(사용자 확인 뒤)
edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) The leftmost strip of the big white cloth hanging in the willow now hangs down much longer, all the way down to the man in the green robe. Instead of pointing, he raises the same hand and firmly grips the end of that strip, pulling it toward himself, so the cloth strips spread apart a little. 2) Remove the gold medal and its red ribbon hanging from the branch; fill with the branch, the bark and the willow leaves. Keep his face, topknot, robe and pose, the willow tree, the other cloth strips, the purple hydrangeas and the grass exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 손이 갈래 끝을 쥠(떠 있으면 실패) · 갈래가 천에 이어져 있음 · 메달 흔적 없음
edits.fallback: 손이 천에 안 닿으면 'the end of the strip is wrapped around his fingers' 한 번

edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) A small white flag with a plain red plus sign on it, like a simple hospital sign, on a thin wooden pole, is stuck upright in the left side of the big nest's rim, with the bottom of the pole pushed into the woven twigs. Keep the nest, all the patterned eggs, the gold medal, the man holding the rim, the knocked-over stool and the purple hydrangeas exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 깃발이 둥지 테두리에 꽂혀 섬 · 십자 하나 · 알 · 메달 그대로
edits.fallback: 깃발이 둥지 밖 땅에 서면 'pushed into the nest's rim' 한 번. 십자가 거절되면 'a white flag with a red heart-and-plus hospital mark'

edits.zone: 옛 그림 이음매: 왼쪽 위 나무 머리
edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. The leafy green crown of the tree is cut off by a straight vertical line on its right side, where it meets the roof of the building. Repair it: let the round leafy crown continue naturally with rounded edges, partly overlapping the edge of the grey tiled roof, and make the pale sky behind it the same color everywhere. Keep the tree trunk, the building, its roof, pillars and windows, the river and the man at the bottom exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 세로 직선 경계 없음 · 건물 그대로

edits.zone: 옛 그림 이음매: 버드나무 칸 배경
edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. The area behind the willow tree on the right has a flat cream-colored background that does not match the rest of the garden, with a straight vertical edge where it meets the building on the left. Make it continuous with the rest of the scene: a pale blue sky at the top, soft green distant trees lower down, and green lawn on the ground under the willow, so there is no vertical edge. Keep the willow tree, the white cloth hanging in it with its torn strips, the young man in green pulling the cloth, the purple hydrangea bushes, the nest, the building and the man at the left exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 세로 경계 없음 · 하늘 · 잔디 이어짐 · 천 · 청년 그대로
